in_sanskrit.name: Shokit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shokit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shiva', meaning 'the supreme god in Hinduism, the god of destruction and regeneration'. Shokit is a powerful name for a boy, symbolizing strength, courage, and resilience. It is believed that those named Shokit are blessed with the power and strength of Lord Shiva.
